bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_CURRENT_PREDEPLOY_CHECK\n'
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'LOCAL_TRACKED_DIRTY='; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'ORIGIN_BRANCH='; git branch -r --contains HEAD | head -3
printf 'CURRENT_CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'videobot|telegram-bot-api' || true
printf 'COMPOSE_OWNER\n'; docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'IMAGE_ID='; docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'UI_MARKERS\n'; docker exec gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 sh -c 'grep -c "変更したい項目の" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs || true'
printf 'VIDEO_GATE_MARKERS\n'; docker exec gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 sh -c 'grep -n "VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED\|VIDEO_REVIEW_NOT_CONNECTED" /opt/videobot/owner/gateOwner.mjs || true'
printf 'DEPLOYMENT_ARTIFACTS\n'; find /home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'compose.videobot.poll.yaml' | wc -l
printf 'PRODUCTION_ENV_KEY_NAMES\n'; docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E '^(VIDEOBOT_|CREATEVDOBOT_)' | sort
printf 'OWNER_DIRS\n'; ls -ld /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot /home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot
